speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is St Valentine's day. If you have a ribbon to send, I have not seen it, and I have seen the desk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no ribbon. I have a penny. I am not in the Knave. That is the company's afternoon. Mine is the Rose.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: You are leaving the dinner. You do that when you are going to look at a thing. The loaf will not be longer for waiting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny's worth of yard, and then home. The moon is full tonight. The almanac had it printed. Leave the desk as it is.
